name: Md Sabbir
tagline: I build clean, useful web apps with React and Next.js.

paragraphs: I am Md Sabbir from Dhaka. I study Biochemistry at Habibullah Bahar College and I am learning web development alongside my studies.

I enjoy turning ideas into simple, useful apps. So far I have built and deployed BazarDor, a Bangla grocery price tracker; FitLog, a workout planner; and DevStack, a tech stack builder. I built them with the help of AI tools, and I am now going through the code line by line to understand it properly.

Tutoring young students taught me to explain things step by step, and I try to write code the same way. I am learning Node.js and Express.js to become a full-stack developer, and I am looking for a junior role or internship in web development.

experience.summary: Taught 3 young students from beginner level up to Class 8, explaining concepts step by step.
Assisted customers and handled day-to-day shop tasks.
